summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, merely disclosing its total voting rights as of August 31, 2026. The filing reports 1,551,043,461 ordinary shares of US$0.25 outstanding, with no shares held in treasury. This is a routine regulatory notification required under UK Disclosure and Transparency Rule 5.6.1 to provide shareholders a denominator for interest notifications. No corporate transaction, strategic initiative, or special situation is involved. The submission contains no terms, advisors, recommendations, or structural details. It is a standard administrative disclosure for a foreign private issuer.
